items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very privileged to have Lonnie Liston Smith with me today...

ctx.x: Lonnie was interviewed via Zoom on January 9, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very privileged to have Lonnie Liston Smith with me today for the Fillius Jazz Archive oral history program. Thanks for joining me.
